section.title: Feedforward POS Tagger
section.para: The learning rate must be finite and positive; the L2 penalty must be finite and non-negative. Invalid settings cause IllegalArgumentException. If a gradient, optimizer accumulator or updated weight becomes non-finite, training stops with IllegalStateException and does not return a model. Check the learning rate, L2 penalty and vector magnitudes before trying again.

Supplied vectors must have a consistent positive length and finite components, including vectors for additional words. Invalid vectors cause IllegalArgumentException; the message identifies the word and, for a non-finite value, the component index. Vectors are copied without clipping or normalization, and training does not modify the supplied arrays.

Scoring multiplies and sums inputs in double precision. Cached contributions retain that precision, so cached and direct scoring produce the same values. The shared cache retains at most 32,768 feature-slot and embedding-row pairs; other pairs use direct calculation. All tagging methods throw IllegalStateException if the model produces a non-finite score.

Loading rejects truncated files, inconsistent dimensions, invalid vocabulary rows, duplicate symbols or tags, and non-finite weights with IOException. Storage grows as values are read; a short file declaring a large array does not allocate that array in advance. Complete models still require memory for their weights, vocabularies and scoring cache. Stream overloads leave the caller's stream open; the Path overload closes the file after loading.

section.title: BiLSTM POS Tagger
section.para: Vocabulary lookup uses StringUtil.toLowerCase code-point conversion during training and tagging, including pretrained vector lookup. Dotted capital I maps to i and capital sigma maps to small sigma without contextual casing. Internal symbols remain unchanged. Older research models whose stored keys used JDK contextual or expanding lowercase conversion may need retraining for affected Unicode words; stored vocabularies are not rewritten on load.

Taggers created from the same BilstmPOSModel share a cache of up to 100,000 token representations, including during concurrent requests. Creating another tagger or calling enableRepresentationCache again preserves cached entries. After the cache is full, uncached tokens are computed without being stored. Reuse the model across requests to reuse this work. Cache memory depends on token lengths and representation width; it is released with the model and is not included in saved model files. BilstmRepresentationCacheTest checks shared taggers, concurrent limits, result copies and independent loaded models.

Loading accepts binary formats ONLP-BLPT-1 through ONLP-BLPT-5, including the CRF, stacked encoder and adapter variants. Invalid vocabularies, incompatible layer dimensions, non-finite weights and truncated files cause IOException during loading. Parameter storage grows as values are read; large models still require enough memory for their parameters. Stream overloads leave caller-owned streams open. Null streams and paths cause IllegalArgumentException. BilstmPOSModelValidationTest checks the formats and file round trip.

Training settings must use finite numbers within their allowed ranges. The gate widths and combined word input width must fit positive integer array lengths. Training checks the width added by pretrained vectors before allocating parameters. Invalid dimensions cause IllegalArgumentException; valid dimensions still require enough heap for the model and training state. BilstmDimensionTest checks these limits, including vectors supplied only through an additional lexicon. Pretrained vectors must have a consistent positive length and finite components, including vectors requested for an additional lexicon. Invalid settings or vectors cause IllegalArgumentException; vector errors identify the word and component index. Training copies provider arrays before storing or fine-tuning them. Multi-task sample arrays must contain no null elements; absent auxiliary taggings can use a null array. MultiTaskSample copies constructor inputs, returns copies from its accessors, and compares samples by array contents. A stream can reuse its input buffers without changing samples it has already returned. BilstmSampleOwnershipTest compares training from reused buffers with independent samples. A literal *UNK* token uses the reserved unknown-word embedding.
Training clips gradients before each Adam update and calculates softmax loss from score differences. Non-finite scores, loss, gradients or optimizer updates stop training with IllegalStateException.

Tagging and BilstmPOSModel.score reject null token arrays or elements with IllegalArgumentException. Empty token strings are accepted. An empty array produces an empty tagging, but cannot be passed to score. Both decoders and score throw IllegalStateException if a computed tag score is not finite, identifying the token and tag indices. This can result from arithmetic overflow even when the model file contains only finite parameters.
